data.content_ref: inline:Reformulate reinstatement as a second-order recurrence over defense depth: a node is IN at pass n iff all its attackers are OUT at pass n−1 and at least one fully IN defense chain of length ≥2 exists at pass n−2. Labels are a linear recurrence over the same graph, so determinism and polynomial cost hold, but the semantics is strictly more decisive than standard grounded in densely defended regions and is no longer Dung grounded — a genuine semantics change, not an extension.
